parsed.rationale: Both members are `type-alias-object` records with empty `fields_or_signature` lists and no structural evidence (jaccard, shared_field_count, shared_ancestor are all null), so there is no substantive shape overlap to act on. The two files — `AppServicesTests/AppConfigurationTests.swift` in the `AppServices` package and `MetadataTests/PlaycutMetadataServiceHTTPTests.swift` in the `Metadata` package — live in separate test targets and share only the name `MockURLProtocol`, which is an extremely common test-helper name for stubbing `URLProtocol` in networking tests. The coincidence is purely nominal; each package legitimately needs its own local mock without any shared contract. Consolidating them would couple two otherwise independent test targets for no functional gain.
